//: Snippet to merge into the project's .claude/settings.json. The two hooks below run the drift checker after the agent finishes editing files (Stop) and before any commit (PreToolUse on Bash for `git commit`). Together they prevent the agent from leaving the repo in a drifted state and from committing drift if the user runs `/auto`.

hooks.command: python3 scripts/consistency.py --root . || (echo 'consistency: drift detected — fix before continuing' >&2; exit 2)
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git commit'; then python3 scripts/consistency.py --root .; fi
